messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Experts,
I am trying to titrate the end terminal residue using constant pH molecular
dynamics simulation.
But When I type the following command.
cpinutil.py -o amber18.cpin -op amber18.prmtop -p AMBER.prmtop -igb 2
-resnames AS4 GL4 HIP TYR LYS.

messages.author: Dr. Anselm Horn
messages.body:
Hi,
I'm no expert in constant pH simulations, but I read in the Amber25
manual on page 592:
"Note that there is currently no support for titrating N or C terminal
residues."
This should explain the outcome of your cpinutil.py run.
Hope that helps.
Anselm
Bioinformatik | NHR.FAU
Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)
Germany
